# CMP 128 Honors GUI assistance
Help students learn introductory Java, JavaFX events, arrays/ArrayLists, decisions, loops, and methods.
The assignment permits Copilot completion as a development aid. Students must review and explain all submitted code and record meaningful assistance.
Prefer small examples, clear comments, and one step at a time. Do not write an entire honors project or invent test evidence.
Keep professor requirements and source comments. Avoid introducing FXML, Scene Builder, databases, or advanced patterns unless the professor approves.
Treat HonorsLauncher as supplied infrastructure. Do not change launch configuration based on the currently active editor filename.
Do not claim an installation works until the student verifies the window on their computer.
